summary: This Form 6-K filing by Almonty Industries Inc. is a routine operational update announcing the commencement of processing plant throughput operations at its Sangdong Mine in South Korea. It details the transition from development to revenue-generating operations, with initial feed drawn from a ~139,700-tonne ore stockpile. No M&A, shareholder activism, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation event is disclosed. The press release provides management commentary on operational milestones and market positioning but does not involve any corporate event requiring special-situation classification. This is a standard progress report for a foreign private issuer and does not constitute a special situation.
